about: P62 T9 sealed set B: 24 new English sentences written 28. 10. 2026 before any place fix (T10), from nouns only (no competitor game, no run on these sentences). Families: interior = the game is played inside a building or underground; outdoor = an open-air place; compound = a place named by two words that the library has no set for. Every sentence names a place. hero, foe, item and world are the sentence's own words, labelled when written. Opened once in T12 (holdout-b-opened.json); nothing is tuned on it.

sentences.text: A librarian shushes noisy goblins hiding between the bookshelves of an old library
A waiter catches falling plates before they smash in a busy sushi restaurant
A night nurse switches off beeping alarm clocks in every room of a sleepy apartment
A plumber stomps giant cockroaches crawling out of the drains in a school bathroom
A miner rides a rail cart through a gold mine and grabs every nugget
A knight battles fire-breathing dragons for a pile of gold deep in a dungeon
A ballerina twirls across the stage of an opera house while roses rain down
A scientist zaps escaped slime blobs inside a secret laboratory
A rodeo rider ropes wild horses that bolt across a dusty ranch
A mountain goat leaps between ledges on a steep rocky cliff while eagles dive
A gardener squashes slugs before they eat the lettuce in a vegetable garden
A kid on an inflatable duck dodges water cannons at a crowded water park
A pilot dodges lightning bolts while flying a biplane above the clouds
A camper scares raccoons away from the tents at a lakeside campsite
A zookeeper chases escaped monkeys around the zoo before closing time
A pirate captain sinks navy warships with cannonballs on the open sea
A fishmonger tosses slippery fish into buckets at a busy fish market
A porter catches falling suitcases on the platform of a train station
A hockey player slaps pucks past the goalie on an indoor ice rink
A golfer chips balls past sand traps and ponds on a seaside golf course
A bowler rolls a ball at wobbling pins in a neon bowling alley
A mechanic stacks tires as high as possible in a car repair garage
A skateboarder grinds rails and dodges traffic cones in a skate park
A kid grabs falling lollipops before they hit the floor of a candy store
